label: Playwright tests
summary: Playwright tests are the third layer in Maaike's three-layer testing strategy for her static site. They cover end-to-end behavioural checks on the library page: filter logic, sort order, and drawer state. The tests are deliberately written from a user perspective rather than testing implementation details.
open_questions: The content validator doesn't run automatically yet — the same gap could in principle exist for Playwright tests if the habit of running them manually slips.
The tests currently cover only the library page; it's unresolved whether interactive components added elsewhere would get the same treatment or fall through.
